Potency within identical nanomolar tier (5-27 nM) and steepness (|nH| > 4.0) replicated across all 3 independent consortia.
Sub-15 nM microtubule stabilization confirmed in GDSC2 and CTRPv2 with high goodness of fit (R2 > 0.98).
Exact EC50 match (4.8 nM) between PRISM and CTRPv2; confirmed steep response (|nH| = 2.24).
Consistent low-micromolar/nM sensitivity in PRISM and GDSC2; CTRPv2 shows active inhibition but slightly lower slope.
Pancreatic cancer nucleoside inhibitor sensitivity verified across PRISM, GDSC2, and CTRPv2 (all within 5-12 nM).
Negative Finding: CTRPv2 reports EC50 = 6.01 uM vs PRISM 7.8 nM (~770-fold shift). Likely reflects assay-specific seeding density or multi-drug efflux resistance.
Negative Finding: CTRPv2 replicate failed curve fit QC (R2 = 0.31) with high discrepancy, despite GDSC2 confirming 4 nM sensitivity.
Untestable: Floxuridine monotherapy was omitted from GDSC2 and CTRPv2 standard libraries (5-Fluorouracil was screened as analog).
